command:
set -e
W=/Users/u/Projects/demo
E=$(mktemp -d "$TMPDIR/demo-e2e.XXXXXX")
echo "E=$E"
git clone --quiet --bare --no-local "$W" "$E/origin.git" 2>&1 | tail -2
git clone --quiet "$E/origin.git" "$E/repo"
git -C "$E/repo" checkout --quiet main 2>/dev/null || git -C "$E/repo" checkout --quiet -b main origin/feature/publish-dry-run
git -C "$E/repo" log --oneline -1
for f in app/scripts/release.sh app/scripts/release.test.ts app/package.json app/vitest.config.mts README.md docs/runbook.md; do cp "$W/$f" "$E/repo/$f"; done
# e2e only: release:run does a dry run and prints a fake version id instead of publishing
sed -i '' 's#"release:run": ".*"#"release:run": "pnpm run check \&\& pnpm run build \&\& wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-dry \&\& echo Current Version ID: 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000e2e00"#' "$E/repo/app/package.json"
grep -n 'release' "$E/repo/app/package.json"
git -C "$E/repo" -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit --quiet -am "e2e"
git -C "$E/repo" add -A && git -C "$E/repo" -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit --quiet -m "e2e new files" || true
git -C "$E/repo" push --quiet origin HEAD:main
git -C "$E/repo" status --short | head; git -C "$E/repo" rev-parse --short HEAD origin/main
echo "$E" > /private/tmp/claude-uid/-Users-u-Projects-demo/00000000-0000-4000-9000-000000000001/scratchpad/e2e-dir.txt
